$comment: Packages the image installs globally so the servers in config/mcp/ start from a binary rather than resolving through npx at every session.
$why: No server is loaded by default. The launcher passes --mcp-config for the categories asked for and --strict-mcp-config, because an MCP server's cost is the tool definitions it puts in every prompt, not the disk it occupies.

@playwright/mcp.why: browser automation as tool calls. No browser is installed, so the tools error until one is: the image is for code, not for driving Chrome

firebase-tools.why: Firestore, Auth, Hosting, App Hosting, deploys. `--dir .` resolves the project from the cwd, so it follows whichever repo is mounted
